Title: Azure Data Explorer: Create a table with the new 1-click experience

Body.Content:
One-click table creation in Azure Data Explorer helps you ramp-up quickly to create database tables and mapping structures. Select data from different kinds of sources in different data formats to define the table schema.

To access the wizard from the Azure Data Explorer web UI, right-click the database row in the left menu of the Azure Data Explorer web UI and select“Create Table”.

 

The service automatically generates a schema, which can then be edited at any time.  You can add new mapping based on your data source.

Feel free to use this tool to explore at will, as there is the option to revert all changes.

Read more about one-click ingestion.
